001package services;
002
003import java.io.*;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import base.User;
009import enums.Role;
010import models.Course;
011import models.CourseRegistrationRequest;
012import models.Student;
013import models.Teacher;
014import services.Logger;
015
016/**
017 * Singleton class representing the central data repository.
018 * Handles Binary Serialization to database.dat and implements Observer broadcasting.
019 */
020
021public class Database implements Serializable {
022    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
023    private static Database instance;
024    private static final String DATA_FILE = "database.dat";
025
026    public List<User> users = new ArrayList<>();
027    // Legacy string catalog kept for compatibility with previous serialized data.
028    public List<String> courses = new ArrayList<>();
029    public List<Course> courseCatalog = new ArrayList<>();
030    public List<String> news = new ArrayList<>();
031    public List<CourseRegistrationRequest> registrationRequests = new ArrayList<>();
032    public Map<String, Integer> teacherRatings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
033
034    private Database() {}
035    /** @return the unique instance of the Database (Singleton) */
036
037    public static Database getInstance() {
038        if (instance == null) {
039            instance = load();
040            if (instance == null) {
041                instance = new Database();
042            }
043        }
044        instance.ensureInitialized();
045        return instance;
046    }
047    /** Registers a new user in the in-memory store. */
048    public void addUser(User user) {
049        ensureInitialized();
050        users.add(user);
051        Logger.log("User added: " + user.getLogin() + " [id=" + user.getId() + "] with role " + user.getRole());
052    }
053
054    public boolean removeUser(String userId) {
055        ensureInitialized();
056        User user = findUserById(userId);
057        if (user != null) {
058            users.remove(user);
059            Logger.log("User removed: " + user.getLogin() + " [id=" + user.getId() + "]");
060            return true;
061        }
062        return false;
063    }
064
065    public User findUserById(String id) {
066        ensureInitialized();
067        return users.stream()
068                .filter(u -> u.getId().equals(id))
069                .findFirst()
070                .orElse(null);
071    }
072
073    public User findUserByLogin(String login) {
074        ensureInitialized();
075        return users.stream()
076                .filter(u -> u.getLogin().equals(login))
077                .findFirst()
078                .orElse(null);
079    }
080
081    public List<User> getUsersByRole(Role role) {
082        ensureInitialized();
083        List<User> result = new ArrayList<>();
084        for (User user : users) {
085            if (user.getRole() == role) {
086                result.add(user);
087            }
088        }
089        return result;
090    }
091
092    public boolean createCourse(String courseId, int credits, String major, int year, int maxStudents) {
093        ensureInitialized();
094        if (courseId == null) return false;
095        String normalized = courseId.trim();
096        if (normalized.isEmpty() || findCourseById(normalized) != null) return false;
097
098        courseCatalog.add(new Course(normalized, credits, major, year, maxStudents));
099        if (!courses.contains(normalized)) courses.add(normalized);
100        return true;
101    }
102
103    public boolean assignTeacherToCourse(String courseId, String teacherLogin) {
104        ensureInitialized();
105        if (courseId == null || teacherLogin == null) return false;
106        Course course = findCourseById(courseId);
107        if (course == null) return false;
108        User u = findUserByLogin(teacherLogin);
109        if (!(u instanceof Teacher)) return false;
110
111        return CourseService.getInstance().addTeacher(course, (Teacher) u);
112    }
113
114    public List<Course> getCoursesByTeacher(String teacherLogin) {
115        ensureInitialized();
116        List<Course> result = new ArrayList<>();
117        for (Course course : courseCatalog) {
118            for (Teacher teacher : course.getTeachers()) {
119                if (teacher.getLogin().equals(teacherLogin)) {
120                    result.add(course);
121                    break;
122                }
123            }
124        }
125        return result;
126    }
127
128    public Course findCourseById(String courseId) {
129        ensureInitialized();
130        if (courseId == null) return null;
131        for (Course c : courseCatalog) {
132            if (c.getCourseID().equals(courseId)) return c;
133        }
134        return null;
135    }
136
137    public List<String> getCourseIds() {
138        ensureInitialized();
139        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
140        for (Course c : courseCatalog) ids.add(c.getCourseID());
141        return ids;
142    }
143
144    public boolean registerStudentToCourse(String studentLogin, String courseId) {
145        ensureInitialized();
146        User u = findUserByLogin(studentLogin);
147        if (!(u instanceof Student)) return false;
148        Course c = findCourseById(courseId);
149        if (c == null) return false;
150        return CourseService.getInstance().registerStudent(c, (Student) u);
151    }
152    /** Serializes the entire database state to {@value #DATA_FILE}. */
153    public void save() {
154        try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(DATA_FILE))) {
155            oos.writeObject(this);
156            Logger.log("Database saved");
157        } catch (IOException e) {
158            Logger.log("Save error: " + e.getMessage());
159        }
160    }
161
162    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
163    private static Database load() {
164        File file = new File(DATA_FILE);
165        if (!file.exists()) return null;
166
167        try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(file))) {
168            Logger.log("Database loaded from file");
169            return (Database) ois.readObject();
170        } catch (IOException | ClassNotFoundException e) {
171            Logger.log("Load error: " + e.getMessage());
172            return null;
173        }
174    }
175    public User authenticate(String login, String password) {
176    User user = findUserByLogin(login);
177    if (user != null && user.getPassword().equals(User.hashPassword(password))) {
178        return user;
179    }
180    return null;
181}
182
183    /**
184     * Broadcasts a news item to all registered users (Observer pattern).
185     * @param text news content
186     */
187    public void addNews(String text) {
188    ensureInitialized();
189    news.add(text);
190    for (User user : users) {
191        user.update(text);
192    }
193    save();
194}
195
196    private Object readResolve() {
197        ensureInitialized();
198        instance = this;
199        return this;
200    }
201
202    private void ensureInitialized() {
203        if (users == null) users = new ArrayList<>();
204        if (courses == null) courses = new ArrayList<>();
205        if (courseCatalog == null) courseCatalog = new ArrayList<>();
206        if (news == null) news = new ArrayList<>();
207        if (registrationRequests == null) registrationRequests = new ArrayList<>();
208        if (teacherRatings == null) teacherRatings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
209
210        // Migrate legacy string-only courses into Course objects.
211        if (!courses.isEmpty()) {
212            for (String id : courses) {
213                if (id == null || id.isBlank()) continue;
214                if (findCourseByIdInternal(id) == null) {
215                    courseCatalog.add(new Course(id, 5, "GENERAL", 1, 30));
216                }
217            }
218        }
219    }
220
221    private Course findCourseByIdInternal(String courseId) {
222        for (Course c : courseCatalog) {
223            if (c.getCourseID().equals(courseId)) return c;
224        }
225        return null;
226    }
227
228}
